title: PERSISTENT CAMP IDENTITY CHECK-IN
description: The patch claims to simplify progression, then decides whose confusion counts as acceptable loss. Player camps now preserve trophies, naming, and small visual scars from completed seasonal events. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: The base started looking like a home instead of a storage error with rugs. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.

title: PERSISTENT CAMP IDENTITY BREATHER
description: The change decides which delays are atmosphere and which delays are invoices. Player camps now preserve trophies, naming, and small visual scars from completed seasonal events. Daily chores have been shortened so players can leave before the evening becomes a second job.
consequence: The base started looking like a home instead of a storage error with rugs. Engagement dipped, but so did the farewell essays.

title: CLEAN SLATE SEASONING CHECK-IN
description: The feature moves a player-facing convenience into the same room as a business goal. Old progression hooks have been flattened so returning players can experience the new season from a more equal baseline. Consecutive logins now build toward escalating rewards that reset just slowly enough to feel merciful.
consequence: Everyone started together, especially the people who had already finished. The calendar was promoted from reminder to game mechanic.
